HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT
NOTICE : -
It is herby notified for information of all the concerned advocates and/or
parties that, the Hon'ble High Court has been pleased to pass an order for
payment of amount in the below mentioned matters. However, concerned
advocates/parties have not approached the Registry to receive the payment even
after submitting a request in writing. Therefore, all the concerned
advocates/parties are hereby informed to come or send their authorized person
(alongwith original identity proof and Rs.1 revenue stamp) to the Registry of High
Court of Gujarat during the first half of the working days of the High Court
within three months to collect the cheque.
